name: Escape Green
notes: Escape Green 0.2.0-r2. Three seamless biomes (Dusk Jungle at spawn, Sunbaked Dunes south-east, Frost Peaks north-west) with distinct sky, fog, and light, plus sand, snow, ice, and sandstone blocks that are mineable, placeable, and saved. Peaceful animals stand in the first view of each biome center (jungle slimes/snakes/foxes; desert snakes/bunnies; mountains polar bears/foxes/bunnies; meadow-edge chickens/bunnies) on every quality tier; Low still draws the two closest kinds. HUD hint text follows the current biome. A biome-name toast fires on entry. ?debug F6 cycles teleport to each biome center and faces the landmark animals; F7 aggros the nearest slime as if hit; F8 +10 coins; F9 +50 m along facing; F10 or ?debug=noui hides the overlay. Space double-tap flight accepts any 40-500 ms key-to-key gap; G and the touch Fly button still toggle flight. Phone 390 px I/B buttons stay in view. Saves migrate from 0.1.0 egSchema v1 to v2 with no loss. IDB name and Workbox cacheId prefix stay escape-green. SW denylist unchanged. Debug stays inert without ?debug. PROXY draw-call caps: High <=150, Low <=62. Do not mutate after SHA256SUMS.
